general.messageFooter: The Flemish Network of Terms is a federated search service on top of terminology sources of Flemish and international source holders. It builds on the Dutch Network of Terms of the Dutch Digital Heritage Network.
general.poc: Proof of concept — work in progress

status.title: Source status
status.lead: The Network of Terms queries every source directly at its publisher. This page shows per source whether it can be reached and how that went over the past weeks.
status.someDown: {n} of {total} sources unreachable | {n} of {total} sources unreachable
status.barLabel: Availability of {source} per day, last {n} days
status.how: Every {minutes} minutes we send each source one test query from our server. A day counts as reachable when at least 99% of those queries got an answer. Measured since {since}. On grey days this test environment was asleep and nothing was measured.
status.failed: The status data cannot be fetched right now. We will try again shortly.
status.waking: The test environment was asleep and is starting up. This takes up to half a minute.
